title: b7z9.53(b): production sfn_delta with unsigned 32-bit modulo semantics
description: Child of b7z9.53 item (2): promote the sfn_delta oracle from the test-local wrapping_sub (lichen-node/tests/sfn_wrap_vectors.rs:59) into a production function (rust/lichen-node or lichen-core, mirroring python timing/sfn.py sfn_delta:49 (curr - last) mod 2^32), consume it in the vector test, and keep ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json as the oracle.
close_reason: Landed: production sfn_delta promoted to lichen-core (pub fn sfn_delta(curr: u32, last: u32) -> u32 { curr.wrapping_sub(last) }) next to the SFN helpers — spec 09 14.7 unsigned 32-bit modulo arithmetic, mirroring python timing/sfn.py sfn_delta:49. The test-local oracle in lichen-node/tests/sfn_wrap_vectors.rs is retired (aliased to the production fn via ), so the canonical ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json vectors now exercise the production code directly. Unit tests added: normal subtraction, u32::MAX wrap-forward, equal-is-zero — all green; sfn_wrap_vectors 19/19 green; lichen-core 401/401 green post-merge; fmt clean. The tokio::test clippy gate failure (E0433 cannot find test in tokio with --all-features --lib) is a pre-existing dev-dependency feature-gating issue (tokio macros only in dev-deps; separate from this bead) — verified cargo test passes.
